grammar.line_shape: body line beginning with a bare integer 1-60 followed by '.', ')', '.)', or a spaced dash and a non-empty title
grammar.title_rule: retain the source title; remove only a same-line explanatory clause introduced by a spaced hyphen, en dash, or em dash
grammar.grouping: group document-wide by the document's exact marker; begin at 1; advance by 1 or 2 under the existing one-gap rule; split every restart at 1
grammar.duplicate_rule: for identical admitted title sequences, select the occurrence with richer total spans (normally body over TOC)
grammar.no_tuning_rule: the grammar, grouping, thresholds, source frame, and truth labels are frozen before aggregate or classifier outcomes
